title: A path through the head
hook: The entrance and exit can be different places.

doesNotKnow: In many bony fishes, what path can water take as the mouth and operculum pump it over the gills?

misconception: The first explanation of an aquatic animal feature must be correct.
objective: In many bony fishes, what path can water take as the mouth and operculum pump it over the gills?

claims.text: In many bony fishes, what path can water take as the mouth and operculum pump it over the gills? The first panel traces water into the mouth and toward the gills. The second traces it out under the operculum. This is a simplified flow path in many bony fishes; it does not depict every phase of the pressure cycle.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: OpenStax Biology 2e, animal respiration and osmoregulation, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e

claims.text: The two panels are simplified schematics, not observations or measurements.
Water has entered a bony fish’s mouth and crossed its gills. What opening can it pass to leave the head? Water can leave from under the operculum after flowing over the gills.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: OpenStax Biology 2e, animal respiration and osmoregulation, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e
